integrity: Analytic proof checked against an independent exact brute-force finite verifier; conditional uniformity and tie boundaries specified explicitly. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed direct voters on a simple undirected cycle with uniform feasible neighbor delegations; excludes random gurus, heterogeneous weights, nonuniform neighbor probabilities, and arbitrary graphs. Generic rooted-forest methods can underlie the enumeration; no claim of wholly new spanning-forest theory.
title: Cycle delegations have an exact ballot-count law and a sharp two-guru tie extremum
